subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding and plotting coordinates on a four-quadrant grid
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student walks a virtual marker along grid lines (across then up/down) to reach a target point
exercise.pictorial: Student reads and writes the coordinates of pictured plotted points
exercise.abstract: Student plots given coordinate pairs on a four-quadrant grid

misconception_flags: reverses the order of x and y coordinates
